directional_error.wb_certain_subset: same Wilson95 non-crossing subset as frozen core protocol

wb_reference_bootstrap.interpretation: finite final-WB reference uncertainty only; not a joint method-uncertainty interval

topology_sensitivity.scientific_role: prospective directional mechanism hypothesis; no numerical pass/fail threshold
topology_sensitivity.hypothesis: If masking of poorly reconstructed non-dominant providers materially explains the pilot, prediction error and/or optimistic bias should become more sensitive when graph structure makes those provider contributions additive or otherwise structurally exposed.

primary_contrasts.within_world_seq_minus_par_mae: Delta_P^M = MAE_M(P,G_SEQ) - MAE_M(P,G_PAR); masking hypothesis predicts Delta_P^M > 0
primary_contrasts.heterogeneous_minus_symmetric_delta: Delta_het^M = mean(Delta_P2^M,Delta_P4^M) - mean(Delta_P1^M,Delta_P3^M); masking/load-concentration hypothesis predicts Delta_het^M > 0
primary_contrasts.signed_bias_analogs: report the corresponding signed-bias contrasts without imposing an additional directional gate

topology_sensitivity.mixed_graph_role: G_SEQPAR and G_PARSEQ provide mechanistic triangulation, not a clean factorial separation of aggregation from workload shift.
topology_sensitivity.heterogeneity_caveat: P2/P4 jointly alter provider spread and concentrate utilization toward ProviderC; contrast is not interpreted as pure heterogeneity.

sla_component_violation_flags.source: derive from existing top-level L,C,Q ledger and frozen query thresholds

provider_interarrival_statistics.source: native provider arrival timestamps where available without changing execution
